title: Crestline Summit Loyalty Program Terms: One Membership per Person
content:
**Clause 1. One membership.** Under the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program a person may hold only one Summit membership; the number of memberships per customer is 1.

**Clause 2. No second opening.** A new membership is not opened for a customer who already has a membership in enrolled, active or dormant status. The existing membership is used.

**Clause 3. Duplicates.** A duplicate membership found later is merged by a human representative, never by a support agent.

**Clause 4. Re-enrolment after closure.** A customer whose earlier membership was closed may enroll again. The new membership starts at Summit Member with a zero balance; balances of the closed membership are never carried over.

### The check that governs a new enrolment

The customer's memberships on the system record are what decide the matter, looked up by that customer. A statement by the customer that they have no membership does not replace the record.

| Status of the customer's existing membership on record | New membership opened |
|---|---|
| Enrolled | No; the existing membership is used |
| Active | No; the existing membership is used |
| Dormant | No; the existing membership is used |
| Closed | Yes; it starts at Summit Member with a zero balance |
| No membership on record | Yes |

**Hypothetical case.** A customer whose only membership went dormant after a long absence asks to join again. The dormant membership is an open membership, so no new membership is opened and the dormant one is used.
